INVITE FOR Q1 FY27 EARNINGS CALL OF IPCA LABORATORIES LTD 
FRIDAY, 14TH AUGUST, 2026 AT 15:30 HRS IST 
Mumbai, August 6, 2026 : Ipca Laboratories Limited (BSE: 524494, NSE:IPCALAB) will 
organize a conference call for investors and analysts on Friday, 14th August from 15:30 hrs 
to 16:30 hrs IST to discuss Q1FY27 earnings and business update. The conference call 
follows the announcement of the Company’s Q1FY27 financial results on Thursday, 13th 
August, 2026. 
Ipca Laboratories Limited management will be represented by Mr. A K Jain – Managing 
Director  and Mr. Harish Kamath – Corporate Counsel & Company Secretary.  
The call will be hosted by Dam Capital Advisors Ltd.
